nodes.name: One-pot hydrothermal synthesis of NiFe-Ce LDH
nodes.procedure: A mixture of 20 mmol of urea and 8.0 mmol of NH4F was added to 60 mL of deionized water under continuous stirring. Subsequently, 2.0 mmol of Ce(NO3)3·6H2O and 2.0 mmol of Fe(NO3)3·9H2O were added sequentially until a homogeneous solution formed. Pretreated nickel foam (2 cm × 4 cm × 1 cm) was fully immersed in the solution and transferred to a hydrothermal reactor. The reaction was conducted at 120 °C for 6 h. After natural cooling, the Ni foam loaded with NiFe-Ce LDH was removed, washed thoroughly with deionized water and ethanol, and dried at 80 °C for later use.

nodes.name: Preparation of RuO2 Electrode
nodes.procedure: A homogeneous dispersion of carbon black was prepared by mixing 5.0 mg of conductive carbon black with 100 uL of 5 wt % Nafion solution and 2.4 mL of ethanol, followed by sonication for 30 min. Subsequently, 4.0 mg of commercial RuO2 was added to 410 uL of the carbon black dispersion and further sonicated for 30 min. The resulting RuO2 dispersion (10 uL) was drop-cast twice onto 1 cm x 1 cm nickel foam and dried.

nodes.description: Standard OER performance in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: the NiFe-Ce LDH demonstrates an ultralow OER overpotential (220 mV @ 10 mA cm-2) and robust stability at 500 mA cm-2 for 650 h.

In a membrane-electrode assembly electrolyzer, it delivers 20 A for over 800 h with only a 0.1 V increase after 850 h. ... the Co/CoO/CoMoO3 II NiFe-Ce LDH device required only 2.1 V to reach current densities of 1.0 A cm-2.

NiFe-Ce LDH outperformed Ni-Fe LDH and Ni-Ce LDH, achieving current densities of 100 and 500 mA cm-2 with overpotentials of only 277 and 351 mV, respectively. ... The system operated continuously for 300 h at current densities of 100 and 200 mA cm-2... maintaining a stable cell voltage.
Under simulated wind-power voltage fluctuations (1.45-2.25 V), the catalyst maintains stable performance and demonstrates potential for sustainable hydrogen production in dynamic energy environments.

nodes.description: TMAOH Probe Experiment to confirm LOM
nodes.source_text: The TMAOH probe experiment revealed that the OER activity of NiFe-Ce LDH was inhibited due to interactions between the TMA+ and the O2 2- intermediate... further supporting the presence of the LOM pathway.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms alpha-NiFe-LDH structure (JCPDS #40-0215). Ce doping causes a lattice expansion indicated by a (003) peak shift of -0.23 degrees.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction (XRD) results indicate that the diffraction peaks of the material are well-matched with alpha-NiFe-LDH ... the introduction of Ce atoms causes a shift of the (003) diffraction peak to a lower angle ... indicating a lattice expansion

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman shows typical LDH bending and stretching modes (458 and 526 cm-1). In situ Raman detects an OO* intermediate (1000-1100 cm-1) for NiFe-Ce LDH, signifying LOM.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Two prominent bands at 458 and 526 cm-1 ... confirming their structural similarity. ... a new Raman peak between 1000 and 1100 cm-1 was observed exclusively for NiFe-Ce LDH, which can be attributed to the OO* intermediate
